description: Repairs broken fast motion - flips, spins, slow-motion drift, missing transitions. About 0.9 alone, 0.5-0.7 stacked with an action LoRA such as wushu-action. The card states no partition or license; tagged for the keyframe transformer since it is ai-toolkit's default and the wushu card pairs it there
use_when: Fast action whose motion breaks or skips
